attempts.text:
**The window starts in a five-column spine.** Columns 0 to 4, `yaiZ` to `ampH`, are carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 98 to 99.8% of them, and no column here hesitates more than 0.19 bits.

**A fork at column 6 breaks the run.** Columns 5 and 6 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0.4 to 1% of calls, and the model names only 45% at column 6, its 1.44 bits the second most hesitant of the window. Then columns 7 to 10, `hemB` to `tauB`, return to the spine, [[taurine uptake and breakdown]], named 93 to 97%.

**Columns 11 to 15 are fork and variable columns**, in a region of plasticity in 73 to 85% of calls, where the model names 74% at column 12 and hesitates 1.47 bits at column 13, the most hesitant column. The `mhp` genes follow, columns 20 to 27, variable, in a region of plasticity in 65 to 86% of calls, yet named 95 to 99%. The `lac` and `cyn` genes, columns 28 to 35, are named 92 to 97%.

**A spine of `codA` to `yahO`**, columns 36 to 43, [[propionate and cytosine catabolism]], is named 93 to 96%. Then columns 44 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 72 to 94% of calls, where naming falls to 63% at column 48 and hesitation reaches 1.11 bits at column 72. A branch of 5 families runs through columns 48 to 52, carried by 21 to 22% of chromosomes; another of 3 families runs through columns 75 to 77, carried by 14 to 17%.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 0.64 against 0.25 bits, and names fewer genes, 88% against 94%. The 57 columns mostly inside such regions are named 88% at 0.61 bits; the other 23 are named 94% at 0.26 bits. The window ends at column 79, `ecpC`, carried by 33% of chromosomes.

label: yaiZ
facts:
WINDOW: the yaiZ window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yaiZ, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,333 to 3,412 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yaiZ once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.51 bits on average (perplexity 1.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 14,469 calls, named 98%, 0.18 bits; shell 28,302 calls, named 87%, 0.63 bits; cloud 429 calls, named 2%, 3.88 bits. Outside an RGP 14,474 calls, named 94%, 0.25 bits; inside an RGP 28,726 calls, named 88%, 0.64 bits. Columns: 24 spine, 17 fork, 39 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.64 against 0.25 bits) and names fewer genes (88% against 94%); 28,726 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 13 (yaiP) 1.47 bits, RGP 85%; column 6 ("hypothetical protein") 1.44 bits, RGP 1%; column 12 ("hypothetical protein") 1.31 bits, RGP 84%. The 57 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 88%, 0.61 bits on average; the other 23 columns: named 94%, 0.26 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 44-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 72-94%; the least: columns 0-4 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-4 (5 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yaiZ "DUF2754 family protein", yaiY "YaiY family protein", yaiW "surface-exposed outer membrane lipo…", sbmA, ampH. named 98-99.8% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 2 (yaiW), named 98%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 4 (ampH)).
2. columns 5-6 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0.4-1%. named 45-92% (mean 69%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6, named 45%, 1.44 bits.
   5 variable: iprA P 89%
   6 fork: "hypothetical protein" S 44%; also ehaB S 28%, "DDE-type integrase/transposase/recombin…" S 19%
3. columns 7-10 (4 columns) spine: share 91-94%, all P, RGP 1-10%. Genes: hemB, tauD, tauC, tauB. named 93-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 7 (hemB), named 93%; most hesitant at column 9 (tauC), 0.27 bits.
4. columns 11-15 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 73-85%. named 74-95% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 12, named 74%; most hesitant at column 13, 1.47 bits.
   11 variable: tauA S 89% "glycine betaine ABC transporter sub…"
   12 fork: "hypothetical protein" S 60%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 38%, "PIG-L deacetylase family protein" S 17%, "response regulator transcription factor" S 10%
   13 fork: yaiP S 76% "glycosyltransferase"; also "MASE1 domain-containing protein" S 10%
   14 variable: "acetyltransferase" S 78%
   15 fork: yaiO S 79% "YaiO family outer membrane beta-bar…"; also "ABC transporter substrate-binding prote…" S 10%
5. columns 16-19 (4 columns) spine: share 93-94%, all P, RGP 8-23%. Genes: frmR, frmA "S-(hydroxymethyl)glutathione dehydr…", fghA, yaiL "DUF2058 family protein". named 97-98% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 16 (frmR), named 97%, 0.28 bits.
6. columns 20-27 (8 columns) variable: RGP 65-86%. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 20, named 95%, 0.24 bits.
   columns 20-27, share 82-86%, all S: mhpT 82%, mhpE 85%, mhpF 86%, mhpD 86%, mhpC "2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate…" 85%, mhpB 85%, mhpA 85%, mhpR 86%
7. columns 28-30 (3 columns) spine: share 90-94%, 2 P, 1 S, RGP 86%. Genes: lacI, lacZ, lacY "oligosaccharide MFS transporter". named 92-97% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 30 (lacY), named 92%, 0.68 bits.
8. columns 31-35 (5 columns) variable: RGP 68-90%. named 93-95% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 33, named 93%; most hesitant at column 31, 0.54 bits.
   columns 31-35, share 81-84%, all S: lacA 84%, cynX 81%, cynS 83%, cynT "carbonic anhydrase CynT" 83%, cynR 83%
9. columns 36-43 (8 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 15-38%. Genes: codA, codB "cytosine permease", prpE, prpD, prpC, prpB "isocitrate lyase/phosphoenolpyruvat…", prpR, yahO "DUF1471 family periplasmic protein…". named 93-96% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 39 (prpD), named 93%; most hesitant at column 43 (yahO), 0.32 bits.
10. columns 44-79 (36 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 72-94%. named 63-93% (mean 85%), fewest named at column 48, named 63%; most hesitant at column 72, 1.11 bits.
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 48-52, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 21-22%, all S; the branch's families: "ABC transporter permease", "ABC transporter permease subunit", "ATP-binding cassette domain-containing…", "substrate-binding domain-containing pro…", "ASCH domain-containing protein"
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 75-77, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 14-17%, all S; the branch's families: "LysR family transcriptional regulator", "alpha/beta hydrolase", "hypothetical protein"
